overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board members did not deliberate on the letter, which concerned a state election outside the Board's jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members privately deliberated on an August 2014 letter supporting a state representative candidate, with no public discussion before publication.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that any Board member discussed this letter with any other Board member outside of a meeting.
